title: Clean tracked artefacts and scratch files out of the repository

Build artefacts are tracked although `.gitignore` lists `obj/`, three scratch tests with no assertions run on every `dotnet test` (one throws when an environment variable is unset), and stray files sit beside the code.
We want the repository to hold only source, tests, tools, parts and the data the paper uses, with run output written outside the source tree.

Its responsibilities are:
* Untrack `SNP_Evolution/obj/` (`project.assets.json`, `*.nuget.g.props`, `*.nuget.g.targets`)
* Delete `SNP_Evolution.Tests/ScratchCheck.cs`, `ZzSeqScratch.cs` and `ZzStreamingScratch.cs`, keeping anything they check that is worth a real test as one
* Delete `SNP_Evolution/network.json`, `SNP_Evolution/EvenNumsNet.json` (no code reads them), the empty `SNP_Evolution/Test Data/` and `SNP_Evolution.Tests/TestResults/`, and the Office lock file `~$CompositeData.xlsx`
* A list of the data folders (`Test Data/`, `Combined Data/`, `CompositeLowHighGen/`) with their sizes, for the owner to decide what stays tracked

Data folders should not be deleted or untracked by this ticket, because they hold the original paper's runs and only the owner can say what is needed.
A scratch test should become a real test only if it asserts something no other test covers, because a test that prints is not a test.

Where: repository root `.gitignore`; `SNP_Evolution.Tests/`; `SNP_Evolution/Cli/EvolutionSession.cs` (`RunsFolder`).

Done when:
- [ ] `git ls-files | grep -E '/(obj|bin)/'` prints nothing
- [ ] No test file reads environment variables or hard-coded relative paths to `parts/` outside a shared helper
- [ ] The data folder list with sizes is in the pull request description
- [ ] `dotnet test` green

Read first: README "How to build"
